Game Overview

Crossy Dash puts players into a arcade experience centered on navigate treacherous terrain as a daring chicken in Crossy Dash. Maneuver through ever-changing landscapes, dodging speeding cars and uncertain rivers with flawless timing. Collect enticing coins while evading peril for endless adventure. Feel the thrill of constant movement, where every hop is a heartbeat away from excitement and relentless challenge!
